note: Concepts are what lessons teach. A concept is one idea (gravity) that many lessons at many levels point at, so the encyclopedia and the curriculum do not duplicate each other. 'requires' is the concept-level prerequisite graph. Wikidata QIDs are from memory and flagged qidVerified:false until someone checks them.

force.name: Force
force.summary: A push or a pull that can change how something moves.

mass.name: Mass
mass.summary: How much matter something contains; how hard it is to speed up or slow down.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.summary: The pull between all things that have mass; it holds us to the Earth and the planets to the Sun.

weight.name: Weight
weight.summary: The pull of gravity on an object; it changes from world to world while mass does not.

orbit.name: Orbit
orbit.summary: The curved path of one body around another, held by gravity.
